items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: And they had my boy Frog, he was on trombone. And he still is on trombone.

ctx.x: We called him Lucky, but his right name... I couldn't call his right name right now, but we called him Lucky. But he could hit any kind of note on that trumpet. He was really good. He was really good. And they had my boy Frog, he was on trombone. And he still is on trombone.
Did he have a piano player in the band?
